clauses.title: Scope of Services
clauses.text: Orchard Solutions shall provide the services described in Exhibit A (the "Services") to Meridian Holdings in a professional and workmanlike manner, consistent with industry standards. Any changes to the scope of the Services must be agreed in writing by both parties before work begins.

clauses.title: Compensation
clauses.text: In consideration of the Services, Meridian Holdings shall pay Orchard Solutions fees not to exceed $147,000 per invoice period. All invoices are payable within 60 days of receipt. Amounts unpaid after the due date accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.text: All work product created by Orchard Solutions specifically for Meridian Holdings under this Agreement shall be the sole property of Meridian Holdings upon full payment of the applicable fees. Orchard Solutions retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, and methodologies.

clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Washington, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Washington.

clauses.title: Independent Contractor
clauses.text: Orchard Solutions is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employment relationship between the parties. Orchard Solutions is solely responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and employee obligations.

clauses.title: Entire Agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement, together with its exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement between Meridian Holdings and Orchard Solutions with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties.
